notes: Minimal macOS integration based on upstream open-svpflow 0.1.3. Fixes signed vector decoding when the vertical component is negative, with regression tests for the real producer/consumer paths. Adds a launcher and configurable VapourSynth graph for separately installed mpv, Python and VapourSynth. Includes eleven interpolation controls documented in README. The ARM64 plugins are built and tested in CI and ad-hoc signed; they are not notarized. No player dependencies are bundled. This is a prerelease; local headless tests do not establish screen presentation or universal quality improvements.
